Which statement about the halogens and their compounds is correct?
A
The colour of the element gets lighter going down Group VII.
B
The elements get less dense going down Group VII.
C
When chlorine is added to sodium iodide solution, iodine is formed.
D
When iodine is added to sodium bromide solution, bromine is formed.
